scope: Exact new lifecycle tests against the previous main KSAudio source with browser API doubles; not a physical iOS recording.
intentionalRegressionFailures: not ok 1 - page setup stays silent until a gesture and requests playback before constructing its one audio context
not ok 3 - a fresh user gesture reclaims a playback session reset by the platform
not ok 4 - an interrupted unlocked engine recovers on foreground return without rebuilding or restarting the recorded track
not ok 5 - failed foreground recovery remains retryable by the next user gesture
not ok 6 - a platform-restored running context resumes the interrupted media slot without a foreground event
not ok 8 - a rejected recorded-slot resume keeps its retry and resumes at its saved position on a gesture
preservedPasses: ok 2 - unsupported or restricted audioSession does not disable the established sound path
ok 7 - foreground events cannot start never-unlocked, muted, zero-volume or hidden audio
